title: Coral and the Current
author: Cyrus Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Winterbourne, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
